items.q: He was at the totally into Woody Shaw and Freddy

ctx.x: On the bus I was a mess. I was a hippie. But you know they had the white dinner jackets, I was fine on the bandstand. You would do a ponytail this way. They never judged me. You know, if they did they sure kept it quiet. We went to Ethiopia, we went to Haile Selassie’s palace, and there were like, there was like Barrie Lee Hall, you know who he is, a great trumpet player. Barrie Lee Hall. He sat at the feet of Cootie Williams and learned how to play. He was at the totally into Woody Shaw and Freddy and he joined…
No kidding. You weren’t ready for that.
